README
TEST05.5 -- Scientific Audit and F2S Hypothesis Validation
Research question: after actively trying to disprove it, is
Frequency-to-Spatial (F2S) Distillation still the best-supported hypothesis
for transferring AdaIR's degradation-aware representation into a NAFNet
student?
Full report: report/test05_5_report.md
Design doc: report/test05_5_design.md
GO/NO-GO decision: report/GO_NO_GO.md
DIRECTORY RULE
Everything for this experiment lives under test05_5/. test01-05, the
original AdaIR source, and the checkpoint are read-only references and were
NOT modified. test01's model_variants.py and test04's manual_forward /
metrics_utils are imported read-only, not modified.
HEADLINE RESULT -- H_F2S IS CONTRADICTED
Across four independent frequency-path interventions (T1 disabled, T2
content-blind matched-random noise, T3 phase-scrambled, and a cross-image
frequency-branch swap), degradation-classification accuracy, PCA-16
compactness, degradation/scene ratio, and restoration output quality are
ALL unchanged relative to the real (T0) frequency processing. Swapping in a
completely different image's frequency-branch content changes the final
output by only L2=0.008 (SSIM=0.99999). This extends TEST01's original
<0.004dB output-quality finding to the representation level: whatever
makes AdaIR's internal representation degradation-aware, it is not the
frequency-domain computation specifically -- at this benchmark resolution,
where the learned mask is degenerate (h_=w_=0, reconfirmed a 6th
independent time here).
WHAT SURVIVED THE AUDIT
- Degradation-discriminability of latent_pre/AFLB outputs: SUPPORTED,
strengthened by severity-generalization testing (Phase 3-4).
- Compact PCA-16 representation: SUPPORTED, re-verified leakage-safe
(Phase 2) and validated against negative controls (Phase 12-14) --
TEST05's original leaky number was NOT inflated (99.67% vs 99.7%).
- Causal relevance of the representation to output: SUPPORTED in general,
but TEST04's "scene dominates degradation" headline finding is now shown
to have been an artifact of its Rain-only recipient subset -- the
degradation-specificity ratio reverses (favors degradation, 1.89-2.10x)
once generalized across all three degradations (Phase 5-6).
WHAT DID NOT SURVIVE
- TEST05's original "Noise = 89.9-99.3% low-frequency feature energy"
finding does NOT replicate under an independent re-measurement (Phase
11) -- feature-level frequency-band fractions are nearly identical
across Rain/Haze/Noise. Only INPUT-level frequency correctly differs as
expected.
- The core F2S causal claim (frequency processing -> useful degradation
representation) is CONTRADICTED (Phase 7-10), not merely unsupported.
FINAL DECISION: GO WITH MODIFICATIONS
Proceed with compact-embedding-based distillation into NAFNet, but
abandon the frequency-causal "F2S" framing/mechanism. See GO_NO_GO.md
questions 9-10 for the specific TEST06 redesign.
